sources.title: O'Connor: Rethinking the Neolithic in Island Southeast Asia
sources.note: Archaeological critique of treating pottery, crops, animals, and language movement as one universal package.

sources.title: Denham and colleagues: Ten Thousand Years of Cultivation at Kuk Swamp
sources.note: ANU Press monograph presenting Kuk excavations, chronology, environmental evidence, cultivation, and interpretive limits.

sources.title: Haberle: Prehistoric human impact on rainforest biodiversity in highland New Guinea
sources.note: Peer reviewed pollen and charcoal record of long, locally variable forest disturbance and cultivation.

sources.title: Denham and colleagues: Ten Thousand Years of Cultivation at Kuk Swamp, overview
sources.note: ANU Press overview of Kuk phases, dates, field systems, preservation, and interpretation.

sources.title: Golson: Kuk Phase 3 palaeochannels and field evidence
sources.note: ANU Press chapter on Phase 3 straight channels, drainage, chronology, and local interpretation.

sources.title: Fullagar and colleagues: Kuk archaeobotanical evidence
sources.note: ANU Press chapter on starch, phytolith, plant remains, sampling, and preservation at Kuk.

sources.title: O'Connor and colleagues: First pottery in Island Southeast Asia
sources.note: Peer reviewed Bayesian estimates for pottery at Sulawesi, Flores, and Pulau Ay, with explicit uncertainty.

sources.title: Bellwood: The Spice Islands in Prehistory
sources.note: ANU Press synthesis of excavations across the northern Moluccas and their varied archaeological sequences.

sources.title: Bellwood: Uattamdi excavation and chronology
sources.note: ANU Press site chapter on occupation, stratigraphy, pottery, tools, and dating at Uattamdi.

sources.title: Bellwood and colleagues: Northern Moluccan pottery
sources.note: ANU Press pottery analysis covering fabrics, surfaces, forms, decoration, and local sequences.

sources.title: Flannery and White: Animal bone and shell from the northern Moluccas
sources.note: ANU Press faunal analysis of fish, shell, phalanger, pig, dog, preservation, and site differences.

sources.title: Pietrusewsky: Human remains and health in the northern Moluccas
sources.note: Bioarchaeological chapter whose usable samples and phases require strict chronological limits.

sources.title: O'Connor and colleagues: Asitau Kuru, Timor-Leste
sources.note: Peer reviewed long cave sequence including a locally defined Neolithic occupation from about 3800 years ago.

sources.title: Oliveira and colleagues: Timor-Leste archaeobotany
sources.note: Peer reviewed macrobotanical evidence showing no rice or millet with initial pottery and introduced animals.

sources.title: David and colleagues: Tanamu 1 at Caution Bay
sources.note: Peer reviewed five-thousand-year sequence distinguishing pre-Lapita, Lapita, and post-Lapita local histories.

sources.title: McNiven and colleagues: Lapita at Caution Bay
sources.note: Peer reviewed evidence for Lapita pottery, settlement, subsistence, burial, and calibrated chronology near Port Moresby.

sources.title: Faulkner and colleagues: Near-shore marine resource use at Caution Bay
sources.note: Peer reviewed shell assemblages and changing coastal settlement and subsistence before and during Lapita.

sources.title: David and colleagues: Moiapu 3 at the end of Lapita
sources.note: Peer reviewed terminal Lapita settlement, ceramics, food remains, pigs, dogs, and local chronological uncertainty.

sources.title: Greig and colleagues: Ancient dog DNA from Caution Bay
sources.note: Peer reviewed dating and genetic study of a terminal Lapita dog from Edubu and later comparative remains.

sources.title: Galipaud and colleagues: Pain Haka burial ground on Flores
sources.note: Peer reviewed cemetery report with adults, children, jar burial, grave goods, dating, and community-directed reburial.

sources.title: Brumm and colleagues: Genome of a mid-Holocene forager from Wallacea
sources.note: Peer reviewed Sulawesi context distinguishing Toalean assemblages from later pottery and ground axes.

sources.title: Szabo and colleagues: Preceramic shell working at Caution Bay
sources.note: Peer reviewed securely dated shell working and exchange evidence before Lapita ceramics.

sources.title: Denham and colleagues: Plant domestication in New Guinea
sources.note: Peer reviewed review of vegetative propagation, microfossils, domestication evidence, and interpretive limits.

sources.title: Writing New Guinea Languages: Alphabets and Orthographies
sources.note: Linguistic history placing the first developed Motu orthography and school publication in 1877, far later than this card.
